title: The Claude skill that stops it from making things up
description:
Claude can confidently make things up to your face. Here's the skill that stops it: the Claude Council, built by Ollie Lehman. You say "ask the council" and Claude spins up 5 AI advisors that each attack your question from a different angle (contrarian, first principles, expansionist, outsider, executor), then a chairman merges it into one clear verdict. 30-second, one-file install.
